title: Owner check with real batteries
goal: The owner registers two packs and uses the chat commands
acceptance: Copy and paste: `nerv chat "registra la batteria 7 blu LiPo 6S 1300 mAh, resistenze 3, 3.4, 4.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.1"` then `nerv chat "carica le batterie 7 blu"`; expected: battery 7 blue shown charged, a storage reminder scheduled for the evening
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner request at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h). Not a measurement.
